from src.cart import subtotal, discount

assert subtotal([100, 200]) == 300

assert discount(50) == 50
assert discount(-10) == 0
assert discount(20000) == 10000
assert discount(50, min_cents=10, max_cents=100) == 50
assert discount(5, min_cents=10, max_cents=100) == 10
assert discount(150, min_cents=10, max_cents=100) == 100
assert discount(50, min_cents=0, max_cents=0) == 0
try:
    discount(50, min_cents=10, max_cents=5)
except ValueError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError("expected ValueError for inverted bounds")

answer.summary: Added an integer-cents discount helper with explicit inclusive bounds and ValueError on inverted bounds, plus tests; left the existing subtotal API unchanged.
